data.action: 白无垢端坐神前捧扇，闻誓词睫毛颤动落泪红瞳
data.camera: wide shot, formal portrait, seated bride, shrine ceremony, sacred mood
data.description: 【东京大神宫·婚礼日】纯白无垢的婚纱衬着辉夜挺直的背脊，白色角隐覆在折叠马尾上，她双手捧着扇子端坐于神前。当你说出誓词，她的睫毛颤了颤，红瞳里终于蓄不住泪光——那个把『先告白的人就输了』挂在嘴边的大小姐，此刻放下所有胜负，轻声说：这次，换我先说。我爱你。
data.lighting: 神社檐下柔光与白无垢相映的圣洁光
data.promptProse: Seated upright before the shrine altar, Kaguya Shinomiya holds a ceremonial fan in both hands above her white shiromuku and woven obi. The tsunokakushi covers her folded ponytail as she listens to her companion's vow, red eyes brightening with restrained tears. The wide formal view shows altar fittings and wooden posts around the seated bride. Soft light beneath the eaves reveals white silk motifs and headdress edges, with gentle sleeve shadows preserving their layers.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 白无垢的花嫁誓言·「这次，换我先说」
